name: percent-input
title: Percent Input
description: Percent field that catches 0.15 typed for 15%, 0.25 basis points meant as 25, and values outside the allowed range (150% where 100% is the cap), reads the result back in money (15% of ₹2,000 = ₹300) and offers a one-tap fix.

meta.summary: Catches 0.15 typed for 15%, basis-point slips and rates over the cap, and reads the result back in money, so a rate isn't 100 times off.
catches: Fraction typed instead of percent (0.15 for 15%)
Over max or under min, with a dropped-zero fix (150 → 15)
Money readback against a base amount
limits: "Likely" ranges are heuristics; set likelyMin, min and max for your domain
Locale defaults to en-IN; pass locale and currency for other markets
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid on error and is described by a polite status
Unit switch is a labelled group of aria-pressed buttons
